title: COST (adapter → runner)
description:
What a record (or, with key null/absent, a whole step) cost (SPEC.md §5). Best-effort, but every v0 built-in that spends money or tokens MUST emit it.

`amount_usd` is NOT required: Go's `omitempty` on the float64 field drops a zero amount from the wire, so a free adapter written in Go emits COST with no amount_usd at all. Absent means 0.

`key` may be JSON null for a step-level cost.

detail.description: Credits, tokens, whatever the provider reported.
